village.name: Hero's Village
village.description: A peaceful settlement with friendly villagers and a bustling marketplace.
village.image_prompt: cozy fantasy village with stone cottages and cobblestone paths

merchant-stand.name: Frozen Merchant Stand
merchant-stand.description: A frozen merchant stand located at the entrance to the Frosty Peaks.
merchant-stand.image_prompt: icy merchant stand, frost-covered wooden stall

frozen-peak.name: Frosty Peaks Gate
frozen-peak.description: The icy gates guarding the entrance to the dangerous Frozen Peaks.
frozen-peak.image_prompt: frozen mountain pass with icy gates, fantasy art

frost-key.name: Frost Key
frost-key.description: A magical key carved from ice that can open the frozen gates.
frost-key.image_prompt: intricate ice key with frost patterns

hero.name: Alden
hero.description: A brave young warrior seeking to rescue his mentor.

mercenary.name: Ironfist Mercenary
mercenary.description: A seasoned mercenary who guards the merchant stand and holds the frost key.
mercenary.image_prompt: battle-hardened mercenary, heavy armor, fantasy style

dialogues.before_talk: Ironfist: You'll never pass the gates without my frost key. You have nothing I want.
dialogues.after_talk: Ironfist: You're still here? I'm not trading with a beggar.
dialogues.after_satisfied: Ironfist: Take this key, traveler. Your cause might just be just.
dialogues.hostile: Ironfist: Thief! I'll not let you pass with my key!
